entities.summary: The National Museum of Šumadija in Kragujevac, Serbia was founded in 1949 as the main museum of the city. The museum is named after the historical region of Šumadija. The museum includes buildings that were once part of Prince Miloš Obrenović court, as well as some of the oldest houses in Kragujevac. The museum houses archaeological, ethnological, historical, and artistic collections with over 26,000 artifacts. National Museum of Kragujevac is a cultural institution in Europe, established in 1949-06-01. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
